question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH interest_max AS (
    SELECT im.interest_name, MAX(imt.composition) as max_composition, ANY_VALUE(imt.month_year) as time_period
    FROM interest_map im
    JOIN interest_metrics imt ON im.id = CAST(imt.interest_id AS INTEGER)
    GROUP BY im.id, im.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT interest_name, max_composition, time_period,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition DESC) as desc_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition ASC) as asc_rank
    FROM interest_max
)
SELECT time_period, interest_name, max_composition
FROM ranked
WHERE desc_rank <= 10 OR asc_rank <= 10
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN desc_rank <= 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    CASE WHEN desc_rank <= 10 THEN desc_rank ELSE asc_rank END
